blocks.text: Knowledge is classified in one way according to its source—that is, where it comes from. Another classification considers its subject, that is, what the knowledge concerns. runs.text: Al-Khatib and Nu'aym narrate in

blocks.text: “Once, I passed in front of the Noble Prophet ﷺ, and he ﷺ said, ‘You are pregnant; there is a boy in your womb. When he is born, bring him to me.’ I replied, ‘O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, how could I be pregnant? I feel no sign of pregnancy, especially since Quraysh have made all men and women swear that no man will approach a woman.’ The Noble Prophet ﷺ said, ‘The oath is one matter, but what I have told you is true.’”
